concepts.quote: y is 5, then x is 6, then ++x makes it 7, so w is 7 and x is 7
concepts.why: Traces x++ (y gets old value 5, x becomes 6) and ++x (x becomes 7, w gets new value 7) in order with correct values, matching the run.

concepts.quote: y is 5, then x is 6, ... so w is 7 and x is 7
concepts.why: Applies assignment to this code: each right-hand side is evaluated and the resulting value stored in y and w, with x's updated value carried forward.

concepts.quote: then x is 6, then ++x makes it 7
concepts.why: Fetches x's current value at each step and shows it replaced after each increment, giving final x = 7.
